title: Book Two · Chapter 152: The Side Door
story:
The first practice page shows three doors and a short notice. Ronan puts his name at the top. He keeps his hands flat for a moment before he begins.

The main door is closed during lunch. Students can return books through the side door. They cannot borrow books there. Students can borrow books again after the first afternoon lesson.

On the picture, two arrows point toward the building. One is beside the main door. The other goes around a low wall.

Ronan follows the second arrow with his pencil. It ends at the side door. Then he reads the words again.

Miss Wu comes to his table.

“I have a book to return at lunch,” she says. “Where do I go?”

“Around the wall to the side door.”

“Can I choose another book there?”

Ronan nearly says yes. He sees a desk in the picture. A person stands behind it. Students usually borrow books at a desk like that.

He looks back at the notice.

“No. You can only return a book there.”

“Show me that line.”

He points to it. Miss Wu asks him about the afternoon time. He gives the answer and shows the next line too.

She puts a small mark on her sheet.

Ronan wants to ask about the mark, but the next student is ready. He turns his paper over and waits. Outside, a ball hits the wall again and again.

After the practice, Miss Wu gives the papers back.

“This is an independent result,” she tells Ronan. “You did it without help. Your answers match the notice.”

He looks at the box at the bottom. The word SELF has a mark beside it. The HELP box is empty.

“One,” he says quietly.

“One task,” she says. “Keep the page. We can look at each result at the end.”

In the yard, Leo is trying to balance a leaf on his nose. Mei watches with her arms folded.

“A useful new reading skill,” she says.

The leaf falls before Leo can answer. Ronan picks it up and tries. It slides straight into his mouth.

Mei laughs so hard that she sits on the low wall.

“I can see the problem,” Leo says. “Your nose is in the wrong place.”

Ronan spits out a tiny piece of leaf. “Then you carry it.”

They walk home through River Street. Near Mr Qiu's table, a real notice points around a pile of empty boxes. Ronan takes the clear path. He does not stop to explain it to his friends.

At the green door, he says goodbye. Inside, he puts the practice page in a folder. The first mark sits at the bottom, small and clear. He closes the folder. He goes to wash his hands.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

side door＝侧门；return＝归还；borrow＝借入；match＝与……相符。

## 理解问题

1. 午饭时侧门能办理什么，不能办理什么？
2. Ronan为什么差点答错第二问？

## 读句子

**He closes the folder.**

拆开看：He / closes / the folder.

他／合上／文件夹。
